subject: general
question:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) when + and − are interchanged?

8 − 3 × 4 + 16 ÷ 2 = ?
solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7751840ca1840d12cadc428f84d30e2cdcd5e7f82d52a57de21f2404c58eed88.png] 

Given equation: 8 − 3 × 4 + 16 ÷ 2 = ?

When + and − are interchanged then we get:

8 − 3 × 4 + 16 ÷ 2 = ?

⇒ ? = 8 + 3 × 4 - 16 &di
